curator.note: Release defaults (origin/main): the same candidates and runs, ranked with no Curator decision. Holdout ranking of the Curator's config and six or seven candidate configs on each set (candidates: default, strategy-conversation, strategy-media-metadata, strategy-records, weights-body-heavy, weights-name-light, and plain-bm25 on the code sets). The Curator ran as a Claude subagent (model sonnet) that read only the set's profile, the strategy list, the skill text and the tune scores, because a nested claude -p had no login on this machine; its cost is not metered here. Only the query keys (bm25_name, bm25_path, bm25_body, semantic_weight) of a decision are applied; build keys and semantic_mode are recorded as unapplied. No hybrid candidate: fastembed is not installed. LocBench has no tune part, so its decision rests on the profile alone.
curator.sampling: Code sets: repos over 100 MB left out (--exclude-repo), then --sample 40 --seed 0 tasks per part, stratified by repo. longmemeval and memoryagentbench: --sample 60 --seed 0 per part. The other five non-code sets run in full.
